posts.text: So with this change, fewer towers will be needed, which means lesser business for Exicom’s Critical Power Division. The Economic Times A big 5G change is coming as India doubles radiation limit to global standard India has doubled electromagnetic field limits for mobile networks to global standards. This change allows telecom operators to cover larger areas with fewer towers. The revised radiation rules will come into effect next month, benefiting all...
